name: Administrative work is ONLY permitted on Managed, Encrypted, EDR-protected devices to ensure the highest level of security for high-privilege operations.
conditionsText: Any activity performed using a privileged account
requirementTitle: Administrative work is ONLY permitted on Managed, Encrypted, EDR-protected devices to ensure the highest level of security for high-privilege operations.
requirementDescription: If you're performing administrative tasks, you must do so from a company-approved device that is managed, encrypted, and actively monitored by security tooling. You must not administer systems from personal, unmanaged, or insecure devices.
why: We do not want high-privilege accounts being used from personal or unmanaged devices because compromising the device could lead directly to a major security breach.
